parity_reason: A totals 25 and B totals 30, so the totals differ by more than 1. Contact also differs by 2 (2 vs 4), so the images are not at parity, even though neither has a critical defect.

reference.summary: A white pelican with an orange pouched beak rides a red bicycle along a grassy road under a sun and clouds, with its feet on the pedals and a wing on the handlebar; the drawing is clean and readable.

defects.what: There is no saddle, and the body floats just above the top tube
defects.expected: The bike has a saddle and the pelican's body sits firmly on it

defects.what: The neck is very long and thin, which makes the bird look more like a heron than a pelican
defects.expected: A thicker, shorter neck that fits a pelican's build

defects.what: A cloud sits right behind the head and beak, so their outlines blend into it
defects.where: upper middle, around the pelican's head
defects.expected: The head and beak stand out against clear sky

defects.what: The wing tip only just touches the end of the handlebar and does not look like it is holding it
defects.where: the pelican's wing at the handlebar
defects.expected: The wing tip clearly wraps around or rests on the handlebar grip

attempt.summary: A white pelican with a big orange beak sits on a red bicycle in front of a sky with a sun and a strip of grass; it is clearly drawn, but the bike has no pedals or seat and the bird does not hold the handlebar.

defects.what: The bicycle has no cranks or pedals, and both legs end together at the bottom bracket hub, so the bird is not pedalling
defects.where: the pelican's legs and the bike's centre hub
defects.expected: Each foot rests on its own pedal, attached to cranks on the bottom bracket, so the bird is clearly riding

defects.what: The pelican does not steer: no wing or other part reaches the handlebar
defects.where: the pelican's wing and the handlebar
defects.expected: A wing reaches forward and rests on the handlebar, showing the bird is riding the bike

defects.what: There is no saddle, and the body sits directly on the top tube
defects.expected: The bike has a saddle and the pelican's body sits on it

defects.what: The neck is a short stub, so the head looks stuck onto the front of the body, and the beak is almost as long as the body
defects.expected: A visible neck joins the head to the body, and the beak is large but in proportion

defects.what: The setting is very bare, with only a plain sky, a sun and a flat green strip
defects.expected: A simple outdoor setting, such as a road or path, that shows where the bike is riding while still keeping the focus on the rider
